qa.question: If I have exactly 10 cards in my cemetery including this follower, can I play its activated ability?

qa.title: Q1649 (Nov. 14, 2025)
qa.question: If I evolve this follower with its Fanfare ability, can I evolve another follower using its evolve ability in the same turn?
qa.answer: Yes. Although you can only activate one evolve ability per turn, other abilities that evolve followers do not count towards this limit.

qa.title: Q1651 (Nov. 14, 2025)
qa.question: If I can't select an enemy follower on the field, can I still choose option 1 of this follower's On Evolve ability and have nothing happen?
qa.answer: No. If you can't select an enemy follower, you would be required to choose option 2.
